definitions.explanation: A neighborhood in Shibuya, Tokyo, around Harajuku Station, known as the center of youth fashion and street culture. Its name evokes cheap, colorful shops and crêpe stands for teenagers, while nearby Omotesandō has upscale brands.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {原宿系|はらじゅくけい}: Harajuku style — colorful, playful street fashion
- {原宿駅|はらじゅくえき}: Harajuku Station on the JR Yamanote Line
- {竹下通|たけしたどお}り: Takeshita Street, the narrow shopping lane at its heart

CULTURAL NOTE:
Since the 1970s Harajuku has stood for young, trend-setting fashion, and it is a stop on almost every visitor's Tokyo itinerary. Right beside the station, the quiet forest of {明治神宮|めいじじんぐう} makes a striking contrast.
